description: Express app-project-boilwater application with intentionally attacker-reachable command execution, redirect, and file path flows.

vulnerabilities.description: The public DNS diagnostics endpoint passes an expected hostname from the API controller to a separate DNS diagnostic module, which embeds it in a quoted getent command before calling child_process.exec.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can execute arbitrary shell commands with the privileges of the Node.js process.

vulnerabilities.description: The public redirect endpoint passes the attacker-controlled target query parameter to a separate redirect handler that calls Express res.redirect.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can make users follow a trusted application URL that redirects them to an arbitrary external destination.

vulnerabilities.description: The public document download endpoint passes an attacker-controlled file parameter to a separate download module that joins it with a nominal document directory without validating containment before res.download.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can use relative path segments to download arbitrary files readable by the Node.js process.

vulnerabilities.description: When password-reset validation fails, the application redirects to the attacker-controlled HTTP Referrer header without validating the destination.
vulnerabilities.vulnerabilityImpact: An attacker can cause a user who submits an invalid reset request to be redirected to an arbitrary external destination.
